instruction.text: Lies dir Zuzannas Pläne für das Wochenende durch und beantworte danach die Fragen.
instruction.sound: Lies dir Susannas Pläne für das Wochenende durch und beantworte danach die Fragen

hint.text: Es können mehrere Antworten richtig sein.
hint.sound: Es können mehrere Antworten richtig sein.

atoms.text: Next weekend I will do lots of things. On Saturday I will meet my friends. First, we will go to the mall. There we will buy new clothes. After that, we will go to the cinema and eat popcorn. We will have lots of fun. On Sunday the weather will be great. Therefore, I will go to the park with my family. I will ride a bike with my brother. And we will have a picnic there. It will be a great weekend.
